text: Disciplinary positioningBiological science belongs to the category of natural sciences and is one of the fundamental disciplines of natural science. It encompasses research at multiple levels, ranging from molecules, cells, tissues, organs to individuals, populations, communities and ecosystems. This major emphasizes the integration of theory and experiment, exploring the fundamental laws of life such as its origin, evolution, growth and development, and metabolic regulation.Professional backgroundWith the rapid development of fields such as gene editing, biotechnology, and bioinformatics, life sciences have transformed from traditional descriptive disciplines to experimental and interdisciplinary ones, and have been deeply integrated with fields such as medicine, agriculture, environmental science, and information technology (such as biomedical engineering, synthetic biology, and biobig data analysis).
